sections.title: Governance and Process
items: We have a documented firewall policy describing security intent and architecture
We have formal change control that all changes follow
We track and identify who made each change, when, and why
We review high-risk rules at least quarterly and the full rulebase at a documented, risk-based cadence that meets any regulatory minimum
We have defined roles and responsibilities

sections.title: Tools and Automation
items: We have centralized management for all firewalls
We can deploy rules to multiple firewalls simultaneously
We can simulate rules before deployment
We can analyze rule usage and identify unused rules automatically
We have automated compliance reporting and continuous monitoring

sections.title: Operational Effectiveness
items: Standard, low-risk changes have a median lead time under three business days, from complete request to validated deployment
In the last four quarters, no more than one material production incident was caused by a firewall change, as defined in our incident policy
We can identify systems accessing critical data
We measure unplanned operational work and keep it low enough to leave planned capacity for engineering and improvement (30% or less is an illustrative target)
